binding_status.description: Whether the operator has confirmed the binding or it is still a candidate

connector_ref.description: The logical alias of the connector that reaches this source; also the field the export/import scope filter compares

coordinate_key.description: The override discriminator stored in the fact's identity — bare when there is no coordinate override, else an 8-hex hash of the coordinate selector

doc_subpath.description: An optional fixed sub-path inside the entity folder where this doc type's files sit

doc_type.description: The specific document type this binding locates, or null for the entity type's general home; part of the supersede key

entity_folder_pattern.description: How each entity's own folder is named, binding a folder to an entity by its number token

entity_type.description: The entity kind whose documents this binding locates; part of the binding's own supersede key

file_glob.description: The file match for this doc type, either `*` (no filter) or a single `*.ext` glob

folder_pattern.description: A case-insensitive regex matched against folder names at any depth, used where no single sub-path name holds

lifecycle_folders.description: The status-tagged folders to traverse, each with a folder name and the entity status it holds

sources.description: The ordered list of places to look: each element is one complete declarative locator

store_drive_name.description: The drive's display name, used to translate between the store root and display paths

store_root.description: The path under the store root to start from (null/empty for systems addressed by site+drive)

store_site_id.description: The store's site identifier; required to reach a source on systems that address by site

system.description: The storage system of one source; only SharePoint and Dropbox are crawlable
